blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. prepares to select a new chief justice for a Supreme Court predominantly appointed by former President Rodrigo Duterte. The decision follows the Judicial and Bar Council’s submission of a five-candidate shortlist, which features two senior magistrates who have repeatedly taken opposing positions on major constitutional and political issues.
